word_ranking: Descending aggregated OpenSubtitles2018 form counts, mapped to dictionary headwords; ambiguous forms apportioned. Capitalization variants are added. This is a selected-corpus estimate, not a universal frequency ranking.
sentence_ranking: Descending observed OpenSubtitles2018 counts for selected directly linked Tatoeba sentence pairs; capitalization/punctuation variants are added. No generated or unobserved sentences are needed.
